name: The Story Behind Gitleaks: How a Hobby Project Became a Security Staple
title: The Story Behind Gitleaks: How a Hobby Project Became a Security Staple
description:
Zach Rice, the creator of Gitleaks tells the story behind the open-source secret scanner: how it started, how it evolved, how Betterleaks was born, and why secret detection matters for modern software security.

In this film:

- Early inspiration. How PSP jailbreaking and Kali Linux led to an interest in security tools and system controls.

- The birth of Gitleaks. How a desire for creative control, with TruffleHog as inspiration, led to writing Gitleaks in Go.

- Early adoption. How a viral tweet and community support brought thousands of GitHub stars before version 1.0 shipped.

- Narrowing the scope. Cutting features to focus on one job: finding secrets locally.

- What secret scanning is. How credentials end up in Git commit history, and why catching them early prevents costly breaches.

- The birth of Betterleaks. How Gitleaks led to its successor, Betterleaks.

To learn more about Betterleaks and Zach, check out: 

- Betterleaks GH repo: https://github.com/betterleaks/betterleaks
- Betterleaks website: https://betterleaks.com/
- Zach's X: https://x.com/lookatcomputer
- Zach's Substack: https://lookingatcomputer.substack.com/
